'''Kim Codoley''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 86 from Lynchburg, VA. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| August 1999 – January 2001
| [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 86, Yavin 4 region; Lynchburg, VA<ref name="decsq-yavin4">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/yavin4.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Yavin 4], decipher.com (listings August 1999 – January 2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010115121600/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/regions/yavin4.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sm-fan">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], geocities.ws/plarathas (Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
